data.narrative:
Stardust Solutions is a Series A climate and energy technology company founded by Yanai Yedvab that has raised $75M to date. The valuation universe comprises nine same-sector peers (one public: LNZA; eight private), including later-stage companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and anchors the analysis. Using total raised ($75M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression yields $150M. The Peer-Median method is not applicable; while nine same-sector peers exist, none satisfy narrow-stage and valuation-tier filters (requiring ≥3 datapoints), making sector-wide medians unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $128M (low) to $172M (high), with a central estimate of $150M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression implied value, accounting for execution risk and the lack of tight comparables at identical stage and scale. Key uncertainties include the absence of same-stage, same-tier private peer data and reliance on a single applicable method. Sensitivity to the 2.0x multiplier assumption and the validity of using total raised as a post-money proxy warrant consideration in any forward valuation refinement.
